title: Approve home composition — Redline Pin-up
question: World is locked (Redline Pin-up). Which composition should we build for the home first viewport?

options.label: Title Block
options.thesis: Drawing title-block header; name as sheet title; CTA as primary; experience as taped strip below.
options.viewport: Horizontal title block → huge name → headline → Book 30 min → pin-up strip.
options.risk: Can feel form-heavy if the title block chrome crowds the name.

options.label: Split Pin
options.thesis: Tall taped sheet owns the left; reading column and CTA own the right — partner critique desk energy.
options.viewport: Left pinned sheet with name; right column headline + Book 30 min + stacked plots.
options.risk: Mobile must restack carefully or the left pin collapses.

options.label: Wall Clearing
options.thesis: Dense paper wall behind; clear foreground clearing for name, pitch, red ACTION stamp.
options.viewport: Atmospheric wall → clear center identity → stamped Calendly.
options.risk: Background density can fight WCAG if not quieted.
